Hi Ellen (and Sofia),

Nice to meet you — I'm Marissa on the contracts team. Thanks for sending the master terms. I attached the latest Redwood MSA and a standard order form template to accelerate intake. See next steps below: 

1) Templates attached: Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx, OrderForm_Template.xlsx (stubs) — please review and flag any fundamental concerns.

2) Party & billing info we need to populate the order form:
   - Full legal entity name (for signature)
   - Billing address and billing contact (email + phone)
   - Primary contract owner and legal contact (name, title, email)
   - Signing authority name & title (if different)

3) Exhibit ask: if you need a data residency exhibit, indicate which region(s) and whether data at rest must remain within a specific cloud region — we can attach an Exhibit D for that. If you have a security addendum, please attach it; otherwise we generally rely on our Security Addendum + SOC2 report.

4) Redlines: send any proposed edits in tracked changes to the MSA doc or use inline comments. For speed, let us know which sections you expect to push on (IP, liability cap, data residency, termination for convenience).

5) Signing workflow: we use DocuSign by default. If you require another e-sign system, confirm now. Typical turnaround for a pilot order form is 5–10 business days once party details are complete and legal agrees on core terms.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute intake sync with procurement + legal on Monday. Proposed slots: Mon 11/10 9:00-10:00 PT or 2:00-2:30 PT.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
